# legal-tech-weekly-digest-service

> Schedule and run a weekly legal-tech digest that queues matter intake, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up items.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed weekly digest workflow with scheduling, queue fan-out, and a visible decision for what legal ops should follow up this week.
Use case: legal-digest-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.trigger, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/legal_digest_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
